description: Automatic context-usage tracking, phase/milestone detection, and strategic compaction suggestions and state capture/restore for Claude Code sessions.

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec uv run --no-project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/post-compact-restore.py || command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/post-compact-restore.py || exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/post-compact-restore.py

command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec uv run --no-project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/context-monitor.py || command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/context-monitor.py || exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/context-monitor.py

command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec uv run --no-project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pre-compact.py || command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pre-compact.py || exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pre-compact.py
